title: clausena dunniana var. robusta
intro: Clausena dunniana var. robusta, commonly known as Robust Clausena, is a plant species belonging to the Rutaceae family, native to China. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Clausena dunniana var. robusta include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing fever, relieving coughs, and soothing digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Clausena dunniana var. robusta include its bioactive constituents, such as limonoids and coumarins, which contribute to its antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-cancer properties, making it a promising natural remedy for various diseases.
